title: Present perfect vs past simple · 典型例句
summary: Determine the tense by whether there is a past time adverbial and whether the present result matters.本课为典型例句练习,核心:Present perfect emphasizes impact on the present; past simple states a past event with an explicit past time。
points: with yesterday, last year, in 2010 use the past simple
with already, yet, so far use the present perfect
just now = just a moment ago, use the past simple; just = just now, use the present perfect
have been to = went and came back; have gone to = went and hasn't returned
when asking about experience use Have you ever...

examples.en: I saw this movie last week.
examples.zh: 我上周看了这部电影。

examples.en: She has lost her keys and can't open the door.
examples.zh: 她丢了钥匙,打不开门。

examples.en: Sam went to Toronto in 2019.
examples.zh: 山姆2019年去了多伦多。

examples.en: He has worked here since last year.
examples.zh: 他从去年起一直在这里工作。

examples.en: They came back just now.
examples.zh: 他们刚回来。

examples.en: So far we have learned five units.
examples.zh: 到目前为止我们学了五个单元。

questions.prompt: I _____ this movie last week.
options: have seen
has seen
saw
see
questions.explanation: 考查Present perfect emphasizes impact on the present; past simple states a past event with an explicit past time。此处应为 saw。句意:我上周看了这部电影。

options: She has lost her keys and can't open the door.

questions.explanation: Present perfect emphasizes impact on the present; past simple states a past event with an explicit past time。正确句:She has lost her keys and can't open the door.

options: Sam went to Toronto in 2019.

questions.explanation: 考查Present perfect emphasizes impact on the present; past simple states a past event with an explicit past time。正确句:Sam went to Toronto in 2019.

questions.explanation: 考查Present perfect emphasizes impact on the present; past simple states a past event with an explicit past time。此处应为 has worked。句意:他从去年起一直在这里工作。

options: So far we learned five units.

So far we learn five units.
questions.explanation: 考查Present perfect emphasizes impact on the present; past simple states a past event with an explicit past time。正确句:So far we have learned five units.

title: for / since time phrases · 典型例句
summary: The time adverbials of the present perfect: for takes a duration, since takes a starting point.本课为典型例句练习,核心:for + length of time; since + point in time。
points: for + a period: for two years
since + a point in time: since 2020
since + clause: since he left
How long...? asks about duration
The main clause of for/since phrases often uses the perfect tense

examples.en: Much has changed since we met.
examples.zh: 自从我们认识后,变化很大。

title: Past continuous · 典型例句
summary: The past continuous depicts what was happening at a certain past time.本课为典型例句练习,核心:was/were + V-ing indicates an action in progress at a past moment。
points: was + V-ing (I/he/she/it)
were + V-ing (you/we/they)
often with at that time, at eight last night
the negative is was/were not + V-ing
the question moves was/were before the subject

title: when / while and the past continuous · 典型例句
summary: was/were doing + when + past simple: the continuous is the background, the past simple is the interrupting event.本课为典型例句练习,核心:The longer action in the past continuous is the background; the shorter action in the past simple interrupts it。
points: when + past simple: sudden short action
while + past continuous: ongoing background
was doing when did = was in the middle of doing something when something happened
while can join two parallel continuous actions
when can replace while + state, but not vice versa

examples.zh: 我正在做作业,这时电话响了。

examples.en: While she was shopping, she met her old friend.

examples.en: While they were playing badminton, it began to rain.

examples.en: He fell asleep while he was reading.

examples.en: When I came in, they were talking about science.
examples.zh: 我进来时他们正在谈论科学。

options: was doing

questions.explanation: 考查The longer action in the past continuous is the background; the shorter action in the past simple interrupts it。此处应为 was doing。句意:我正在做作业,这时电话响了。

title: Past perfect · 典型例句
summary: The past perfect expresses an action completed before a past reference point: by the time / before / after.本课为典型例句练习,核心:had + past participle indicates 'past of the past'。
points: had + past participle
often with by the time, before, after, when
emphasizes the sequence of two past actions
the negative is had not (hadn't) + past participle
in reported speech, the past simple moves to the past perfect

title: Passive voice in the present · 典型例句
summary: The passive voice in the present: be + past participle, emphasizing the receiver of the action.本课为典型例句练习,核心:am/is/are + past participle; the receiver of the action becomes the subject。
points: am/is/are + past participle
by introduces the agent (when necessary)
the negative is am/is/are not + past participle
modal passives: can be done
the passive is used when the agent is unknown or unimportant

Was/Were + subject + past participle?

title: Relative clauses who / that (people) · 典型例句
summary: A relative clause modifies a person: who/that replaces the antecedent inside the clause.本课为典型例句练习,核心:who/that introduces a relative clause modifying a person, as subject or object。
points: who/that acts as subject inside the clause: the man who lives next door
who/that acts as object and can be omitted: the man (who) I met
whom is used as object in formal style
the verb in the clause agrees with the antecedent
do not repeat the pronoun of the antecedent in the clause

the antecedent is not repeated in the clause

title: Relative clauses where / when · 典型例句
summary: Relational adverbs introduce relative clauses: where = in which, when = on which.本课为典型例句练习,核心:where modifies a place, when modifies a time, acting as an adverbial inside the clause。
points: where modifies a place antecedent: the school where I study
when modifies a time antecedent: the day when we met
where can be rewritten as prep + which
when can be rewritten as on/in which
why modifies the antecedent reason

questions.explanation: 考查where modifies a place, when modifies a time, acting as an adverbial inside the clause。此处应为 where。句意:他们住的城市非常安静。

title: Object clauses with that · 典型例句
summary: An object clause serves as the object of a verb like say/think/know/believe; the word order must be statement order.本课为典型例句练习,核心:that introduces an object clause; the clause uses statement word order。
points: that can be omitted
the object clause must use statement word order: I think that he is right
the negative transfer of think: I don't think he is right
the tense follows the main clause
when the main clause is in the past, the clause moves back one tense

examples.en: I think that the movie is wonderful.
examples.zh: 我觉得这部电影很精彩。

examples.en: She said that she would come the next day.
examples.zh: 她说她第二天会来。

examples.en: We know that the earth goes around the sun.
examples.zh: 我们知道地球绕着太阳转。

examples.en: He believes that practice makes perfect.

special question words (what/where/when/how) keep their original meaning
the clause uses statement word order: where he lives
the tense follows the main clause

examples.en: I don't know whether he will come.

title: Adverbial clauses of time with when / before / after · 典型例句

before = before, after = after

title: Present perfect have/has + past participle · 易错辨析

points: have/has + past participle

the negative is haven't/hasn't + past participle

just now = just a moment ago, use the past simple; just = just now, use the present perfect
have been to = went and came back; have gone to = went and hasn't returned

points: where modifies a place antecedent: the school where I study
when modifies a time antecedent: the day when we met
where can be rewritten as prep + which
when can be rewritten as on/in which
why modifies the antecedent reason

the object clause must use statement word order: I think that he is right
